camel_example: aliyun cbn CreateCen --region cn-hangzhou --ProtectionLevel REDUCED --Tag.1.Key tagtest --Description testdesc --Tag.1.Value tagtest --ClientToken '02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-0010000' --Name testname
description_en: A Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance is the fundamental resource for managing an integrated network. A CEN instance manages one network and can span one or more regions. Before enabling connectivity between network instances, call the CreateCen operation to create a CEN instance
description_zh: 云企业网实例是管理一体化网络的基础资源。一个云企业网实例管理一张网络，可覆盖一个或多个地域。在实现网络实例互通前，您需要先调用CreateCen接口创建一个云企业网实例
kebab_example: aliyun cbn create-cen --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-0010000 --name testname --description testdesc --protection-level REDUCED --tag Value=tagtest Key=tagtest --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCen

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The name of the CEN instance.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
云企业网实例的名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the CEN instance.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
云企业网实例的描述信息。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The level of CIDR block overlapping.

Valid values: REDUCED (default): CIDR blocks can overlap but cannot be identical
parameters.help_zh:
设置网段重叠的级别。

取值：REDUCED（默认值），表示网段可以有重叠，但是不能完全相同
parameters.name: protection_level

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

一次最多支持输入20个标签的标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

The tag value cannot be empty. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://.

Each tag key has a corresponding tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空。支持输入不超过 128 个字符的字符串，不能以 aliyun 或者 acs:开头，不能包含 http://或者 https:// 。

每一个标签键对应一个标签值，一次最多支持输入 20 个标签键对应的标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tag information.

You can specify up to 20 tags at a time
parameters.help_zh:
标签信息。

一次最多支持输入20个标签信息
parameters.name: tag

CenId.description_en: The ID of the CEN instance
